from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from portion import percent_of_total

KEY = ROWS[0][0]
TOTAL = sum(v for _, v in ROWS)
PART = sum(v for k, v in ROWS if k == KEY)


def test_percent():
    assert abs(percent_of_total(list(load_bookings()), KEY) - 100.0 * PART / TOTAL) < 1e-6


def test_unknown_key():
    assert percent_of_total(list(load_bookings()), "zzz") == 0
